final_prompt:
You are an Investment Banking Analyst in the Energy & Power group at a bulge bracket firm. Your VP wants a quick accretion/dilution read on the Devon Energy (DVN) / Coterra Energy (CTRA) all-stock merger of equals for an internal sector update note. It's a fixed 0.70 DVN-per-CTRA exchange ratio, announced February 1, 2026 and closed May 7, 2026. Build a one-tab Excel model (DVN_CTRA_Merger_Model_v1.xlsx) that walks from standalone earnings to pro forma EPS and shows whether the deal is accretive or dilutive to Devon shareholders in 2027E, with a sensitivity flexing the exchange ratio and synergy level.

Run it on these assumptions: Devon and Coterra diluted shares of 624.0M and 759.0M; consensus net income for Devon of $2,650M (2026E) and $2,850M (2027E) and for Coterra of $1,420M (2026E) and $1,560M (2027E); $1.0bn of pre-tax run-rate synergies phasing in 50% in 2026E and 100% in 2027E; a 21% tax rate; and no financing, incremental interest, or fees since it's all-stock. Center the sensitivity on the 0.70 ratio and $1.0bn synergies, flexing the ratio from 0.60 to 0.80 and synergies from $500M to $1,500M.
